title: Public Study demo solution manifest
description: Versioned manifest for one precomputed Hold'em Study demo example (flop-explore or river-lock). Artifacts live under desktop/public/demo/<id>/ and are fetched by URL path (/demo/...).

label.description: UI badge text; always Precomputed for this pack.

config_path.description: Repo-relative street-config 1 input used for this export.

engine_build_sha.description: git rev-parse HEAD at export time (solver-engine source tip).

resolve_iterations.description: Iterations for resolve_locked (river lock preset only).

max_chance_children.description: Flop: max card children materialized under each chance node. null = unlimited (river).

root_node_id.description: Study public node id; root is always p0.t-1.r-1 after publish.

bet_sizes.description: street-config bet/raise keys as written (e.g. oop-bets, ip-river-bets).

ev_units.description: Host values.units — chip EV (not pot fraction).

equity_units.description: Host equity.units — check-down pot fraction, not chip EV.

utility_basis.description: Primary values columns are local decision EV (Fold≈0).

combo_weights.description: How combo mass is weighted for matrix mix / expected.json.

action_labels.description: Source of action label strings (must match Study / host).

chunk_layout.description: Per-node/branch file layout for lazy fetch.

initial_view.description: Minimal URL paths for first paint (catalog + root pack).

pack.description: Directory under the example containing status/index/nodes/…
